Name: Stardew Enhanced - The Town
Author: XCube591
Description:
[center][/center][font=Arial]the Town  reimagines and adds detail to our beloved
Pelican Town to make it feel fresh even after countless
playthroughs, while keeping the vanilla feel of the
game.

﻿[b]Patchnotes [/b][spoiler]
[b]3.0.1 [/b]- Ported  to 1.6.0, fixed Haley 14-heart event, added a Sewer
[b]2.0.3 [/b]- Fixed issue with NPCs getting stuck during Linus Town Event   
[b]2.0.2 - [/b]mostly visual bugfixes, added a config entry for the garden       
behindthe Blacksmith
[/spoiler][size=2]
﻿___________________

[b]Does this mod add any new locations, NPCs, quests, events, etc etc.?[/b]
No - this mod just improves the locations that are already in the game.

[b]Will this mod work if I add it mid-game?[/b]
Yes, without any issues. It doesn't add any scripts and doesn't change any files, so it's safe to [u]add[/u] or [u]remove[/u] whenever you want to.

[b]Does this mod work with recolours and retextures?[/b]
Yes, this mod doesn't change any tilesheets.

[b]The mod looks great but I don't like [something].[/b]
That's not a problem, you can turn any part of the mod off in the config.json file located in the mod folder.[/size][b]

[b]How to install:[/b]
[spoiler]
1. Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Content Patcher[/b]
2. Download with a mod manager  
[b]OR 
[/b]2. Extract (Unzip) into the Mods folder in your Stardew Valley Directory.
3. Done!

[b][u]If you are applying this mod to an ongoing game:[/u][/b]
As this mod changes some bush  placements, 
it is very important to reset terrain features.

[b]OPTION 1:
[/b]1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4715]Reset Terrain Features[/url]﻿[b] (unofficial edition) [/b]by MabelSyrup.
2. Enter the game
3. Press 'L' / Open up the mod menu
4. Tick "Affect all locations" ,"Bushes" and "Trees"
5. Click "Reset".

[b]OPTION 2:[/b]
1. Download[b] [/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2269]Entoarox Framework[/url][b]﻿ [/b]by Entoarox
2. Enter the game
3. Alt + Tab and select the SMAPI console*
*(the black window with a Stardew Valley logo that opens alongside your game)
4. Type [b]"world_bushreset"[/b] without the quotation marks.
[/spoiler]
